fix_subject: fix(ci): harden VEKL and Studio certification seams
resolution: Added a cross-platform compiled-test launcher so the same test inventory executes on Windows and POSIX hosts.
root_cause: The npm test path relied on a POSIX-style out/shared/*.test.js shell glob that Windows did not expand.
symptom: The Windows DDE Studio compile job could not execute the compiled shared test set even though the tests were valid.
title: Windows Studio client tests depended on shell glob expansion

fix_subject: fix(ci): harden VEKL and Studio certification seams
regression_tests: DDE Studio Knowledge workbench browser suite 80/80
resolution: Bound the local Vite executable explicitly to 127.0.0.1 so the Playwright readiness probe reaches the exact server under test.
root_cause: The Playwright web-server command depended on indirect Vite startup/binding behavior that did not reliably become reachable in CI.
symptom: The Linux workbench browser job timed out before structural tests could run.
title: Playwright workbench server failed to become ready in CI

fix_subject: fix(ci): harden VEKL and Studio certification seams
resolution: Added knowledge_context to the SQLAlchemy activation-manifest table and protected the mapping with regression coverage.
root_cause: Migration, JSON schema, and generated contract added knowledge_context but engine/vekl/tables.py was not updated in the same change.
symptom: Service-backed VEKL tests failed after migration because runtime inserts referenced a schema field absent from SQLAlchemy table metadata.
title: VEKL activation manifest ORM omitted knowledge_context

fix_subject: fix(vekl): normalize knowledge persistence and browser assertion
resolution: Normalized nested JSONB values to JSON-safe representations at the repository boundary while retaining native UUIDs in typed PostgreSQL UUID columns.
root_cause: Knowledge repository writes used raw model_dump values for JSONB payloads, leaving UUID objects for the JSON encoder.
symptom: PostgreSQL integration failed while persisting Unit knowledge structures containing UUID-valued JSONB references.
title: VEKL JSONB persistence attempted to serialize raw UUID objects

fix_subject: fix(vekl): close graph selection and invalidation contracts
resolution: Aligned the runtime invalidation path to the canonical VEKL_PROJECT_TRUTH_CHANGED enum and retained strict contract validation.
root_cause: One runtime path emitted PROJECT_TRUTH_CHANGED while the generated contract permits VEKL_PROJECT_TRUTH_CHANGED.
symptom: Accepted Truth Challenge invalidation failed contract validation on the Project Truth change path.
title: Truth-change invalidation emitted a non-canonical reason code

fix_subject: fix(vekl): keep graph snapshots stable across readiness
resolution: Changed Unit graph identity to unit_revision_hash so readiness transitions cannot alter the structural GraphRAG snapshot.
root_cause: The Unit graph node identity incorporated mutable unit_map_hash/readiness state instead of immutable structural Unit revision identity.
symptom: A successful MAPPING-to-READY transition changed the graph snapshot immediately after resolution, making the just-created trace stale.
title: GraphRAG resolution trace invalidated itself on Unit readiness promotion

fix_subject: fix(vekl): stabilize unit graph edge provenance
resolution: Bound the edge provenance to immutable unit_revision_hash and audited the compiler for remaining readiness/challenge/map-hash leakage.
root_cause: The Unit-to-TaskGraph edge provenance continued to use mutable unit_map_hash even though the Unit node had moved to unit_revision_hash.
symptom: After the Unit-node fix, one PostgreSQL integration still observed graph snapshot churn across readiness promotion.
title: Unit-to-TaskGraph edge provenance still leaked mutable Unit-map state

regression_tests: Project Truth Guard on canonical main
resolution: Converted Project Truth automation into a read-only guard, added durable API-backfill handling and pure-merge-carrier semantics, and retained pre-merge staged-diff recording as the truth-bearing path.
root_cause: The original autolog design treated CI as a writer even though branch protection correctly requires main changes to arrive through protected PRs.
symptom: After protected merge, the Project Truth workflow failed because it tried to create and push a follow-up ledger commit directly to protected main.
title: Project Truth autolog attempted forbidden writes to protected main
